title.suggested: Notice for Tom Allen's Saloon at 619 Market Street

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Globe-Democrat's Sporting Notes carried a notice for Tom Allen, 'retired champion pugilist of the world,' at 619 Market Street: free concert every evening, best of singers only.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Saturday Morning, January 24, 1891, page 7.

facts.fact: Allen advertised himself as 'retired champion pugilist of the world' at 619 Market Street, St. Louis, with free concerts every evening and 'best of singers only'

notes: Same notice as 811 (same day, Republic) with an extra line about singers. Focus primary since the item is wholly about Allen; passing also defensible.
